item.title: Colombia Peso Defies Central Bank Bid to Halt Carry-Fueled Rally
item.description: The Colombian peso continues to be the best performing currency in emerging markets as investors shrug off the central bank’s efforts to slow the currency’s rally and instead focus on its carry appeal.

item.title: DeepSeek Resumes $8 Billion Round With Monolith in the Running
item.description: DeepSeek has resumed its second funding round, seeking close to $8 billion, with Monolith Management in talks to contribute, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: SpaceX Shares Steady After $100 Billion Insider Lockup Expires
item.description: SpaceX shares held steady on Thursday as investors digested the release of as many as 911.5 million shares worth about $100 billion from lock-up agreements that had prevented insiders from selling them.

item.title: Why Black Moms Are Leaving The Job Market at Alarming Rate
item.description: Labor force participation among Black mothers with young children has fallen to a 31-year low.

item.title: Top US Mortgage Lender Plunges Most Ever After Pausing Dividend
item.description: Shares in United Wholesale Mortgage fell by a record 49% Thursday, after the country’s biggest mortgage lender announced a net loss of $452 million and suspended its dividend for the first time.

item.title: CMBS Investors Push Back Against AI as ‘Luddite Trade’ Spreads
item.description: Tech companies are borrowing far and wide to fund their artificial intelligence investments, and even in smaller markets investors are growing increasingly wary of the debt.

item.title: ‘India’s Top Gun’ Is Netflix’s Most Ambitious Local Production
item.description: Netflix Inc. is turning one of India’s most politically defining chapters into its biggest production in the country yet, betting that a spectacle on the scale of Top Gun can strengthen its position in the world’s most populous market as a premium video platform.

item.title: New ETFs to Watch: Nasdaq 100 Challenger and Multi-Token Launch
item.description: In this episode, a Nasdaq 100 challenger, SK Hynix and a multi-token launch.

item.title: SpaceX's Next Big Test Is the $101 Billion (SPCX) Unlock: Live Q&A
item.description: Bloomberg journalists answer your questions about SpaceX’s big week in a Live Q&A today at 2 p.m. EDT.

item.title: Bose Debuts Revamped QuietComfort Headphones With Better Noise-Cancellation
item.description: Bose Corp. introduced the latest version of its QuietComfort Headphones, which have a revamped design, improved active noise cancellation and several features carried over from the higher-end “Ultra” model.

item.title: Defense Startup Hadrian Valued at $7.87 Billion in New Round
item.description: Hadrian, a defense manufacturing startup that serves the Pentagon, Lockheed Martin Corp. and others, secured a $7.87 billion valuation in a funding round that will help the company expand its workforce.

item.title: Microsoft Opens Fourth Data Center Region in India for Azure
item.description: Microsoft Corp. announced its fourth data center region in India is up and running as part of a broader $20.5 billion investment in the country to build out cloud and artificial intelligence capabilities.

item.title: Deutsche Bank, KBC Freeze Some Radiant World Funds in Singapore
item.description: Radiant World is under growing pressure after two of its key banks froze its funds and major miners moved to cut ties with the iron ore trading house.

item.title: US Initial Jobless Claims Remain Stable Below 200,000
item.description: Applications for US unemployment benefits were little changed, remaining below 200,000 for a third straight week and underscoring the labor market’s resilience.

item.title: US Labor Productivity Picks Up as Firms Seek to Curb Costs
item.description: US labor productivity accelerated at a faster-than-expected pace in the second quarter as employers sought to mitigate higher costs.

item.title: Wall Street Bulls Flock to S&P 500 Calls as Rally Broadens
item.description: Traders can’t get enough of options betting on more gains in the S&P 500 Index, a gauge that has for months been in the shadow of its more volatile rival, the Nasdaq 100.

item.title: US Stocks Mixed as Traders Weigh Memory Results, Iran Progress
item.description: US stocks were mixed on Thursday as investors weighed progress in the Middle East and grappled with the continued fracturing in the artificial-intelligence trade following results from key memory names.

item.title: Emerging Currencies Hold Near Record High as Carry Trades Revive
item.description: Currencies from the developing world hovered near record highs on Thursday, benefiting from renewed interest in carry trades, though gains were capped by the absence of concrete new developments in US-Iran peace talks.

item.title: Alphabet Is Seeking Up to $25 Billion From Latest Bond Sale
item.description: Alphabet Inc. is looking to raise as much as $25 billion from its latest US investment-grade bond offering, a deal that will test investor appetite for AI-related debt following a July selloff.

item.title: China’s Unitree Seeks $904 Million in First Mainland Robotic IPO
item.description: China’s Yushu Technology Co., known as Unitree Robotics, is seeking to raise about 6.1 billion yuan ($904 million) in an initial public offering that would make it the mainland’s first publicly traded humanoid robot maker.

item.title: Paramount-Warner Deal Cleared by UK Antitrust Watchdog
item.description: Paramount Skydance Corp.’s $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. won approval from the UK’s antitrust watchdog after regulators decided the proposed deal doesn’t raise any competition concerns in Britain.

item.title: WhatsApp Tests Age Confirmation in Largest Market India
item.description: Meta Platforms Inc.’s WhatsApp is testing a new feature that lets users in India add their date of birth, an update to the massively popular messaging service in its largest market.

item.title: Six Flags Shares Slide After Attendance, Revenue Miss Estimates
item.description: Six Flags Entertainment Corp. shares slumped after the company’s second-quarter revenue and attendance fell short of estimates.

item.title: Peloton Gives Disappointing Outlook in Setback to Comeback Bid
item.description: Peloton Interactive Inc. forecast revenue for the fiscal 2027 year that came in below estimates, marking the latest setback for the fitness technology company.

item.title: Record India Sugar Prices Spur Mills to Advance Cane Crushing
item.description: Indian sugar producers are set to start crushing cane earlier than usual in the upcoming milling season as the government seeks to bolster supplies and rein in record prices ahead of the festival period.

item.title: Ghana Inflation Posts Surprise Slowdown on Lower Food Prices
item.description: Ghanaian annual inflation unexpectedly slowed in July as food-price growth eased and a more stable exchange rate helped contain the cost of imported goods.

item.title: Indonesia’s Plan to Overhaul Commodity Exports Is Still in Flux
item.description: Almost three months after the proposal was unveiled, there’s a lack of consensus within the government on what form it will ultimately take.

item.title: Snapchat Users Bristle at Plan to Charge for Memories Storage
item.description: The app plans to charge users a storage fee to save their content

item.title: Warner Bros. Sales Fall on Loss of NBA, Weak Film Slate
item.description: Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. reported a steep drop in sales as it copes with the loss of National Basketball Association rights and a movie lineup that compared poorly with last year.

item.title: How the AI Chip Boom is Reshaping South Korea’s Markets, Economy and Society
item.description: Semiconductor workers are the new social elite as the country finds itself in the epicenter of the artificial intelligence boom.
